{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2283_Objection2",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_WithAndWithoutKey_DoesNotThrowAndGeneratesResolver()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n\n        const string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial struct UnkeyedGenericStruct<T>\n                {\n                    public T UnkeyedProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = CompileToMetadataReference(\"Lib\", libSource, baseReferences);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> appReferences = baseReferences.Add(libReference);\n\n        const string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n\n                    [Key(2)]\n                    public UnkeyedGenericStruct<int> UnkeyedMember { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            appReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await compilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.GetMessage().Contains(\"UnkeyedProperty\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource);\n            Assert.True(compilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree));\n        });\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task CompilingMessagePackObject_InheritingMetadataBaseWithUnkeyedProperty_DoesNotThrowOrReportInvalidLocation()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n\n        const string libSource = \"\"\"\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                public class MetadataBase\n                {\n                    public int UnkeyedBaseProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = CompileToMetadataReference(\"Lib\", libSource, baseReferences);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> appReferences = baseReferences.Add(libReference);\n\n        const string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial class CompilingDerived : MetadataBase\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int DerivedProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            appReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await compilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource);\n            Assert.True(compilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree));\n        });\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<ImmutableArray<MetadataReference>> GetBaseReferencesAsync()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80 = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> messagePack = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        return net80.AddRange(messagePack);\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference CompileToMetadataReference(string assemblyName, string source, ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references)\n    {\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            assemblyName,\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var ms = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = compilation.Emit(ms);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        return MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(ms.ToArray());\n    }\n}"
}
